evidence_items.explanation: The study examines 10,902 headlines from launch through March 2023 and reports favorable sentiment and attention to technology companies. These findings do not establish unexplained revolutionary claims or dismissal of critics in article bodies.

evidence_items.locator: Section “What is ChatGPT?”, paragraph discussing the interface
evidence_items.explanation: The article offers concrete explanations involving accessibility and uses, and gives substantial space to an expert's concerns. It contradicts a categorical absence of explanations or serious criticism, but one article cannot settle the broader pattern.

unresolved_gaps: No retrieved representative analysis jointly measures unexplained revolutionary framing, corporate narrative repetition, and dismissive treatment of critics.
The headline study covers only the early part of the target period and cannot establish how articles explain or qualify their claims.
